sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze. Preserve the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary and all prior instructions. Remove the invalid `sh:hasValue [ sh:this true ]` constraint on `sectionCalculationCaseStructuralMember`: `sh:hasValue` compares against that blank node and does not express identity with the enclosing structural member, so it can make valid data fail or encode the wrong relationship. Keep `sh:minCount 1; sh:maxCount 1` on the property and enforce identity only with the existing SPARQL check (or an equivalent explicit same-node constraint) between the linked local-frame case member and the supplied structural member reached through `hasStructuralMember`.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not freeze this graph. Preserve COMPLEX_READINESS as a readiness boundary, but encode the declared applicability and alternatives: require the z_na branch only when 100*A_fn > 1000*t_pn*s with the stated units, and make linear-interpolation endpoints/results applicable only for 20<framingAngleOmega<70, with branch-selection evidence so missing selector data cannot pass. Do not make interpolation endpoints conjunctively mandatory for every case. Also avoid duplicating the structural-member operands: the localFrameSectionCalculationCase link should identify the same supplied structuralMember reached through hasStructuralMember (or otherwise use an explicitly declared cross-owner path), rather than requiring a second structuralMember node carrying duplicate facts.

Do not freeze this graph. Preserve the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary and the prior applicability/alternative instructions. Correct the owner/path structure: sectionCalculationCaseStructuralMember is declared on localFrameSectionCalculationCase, not calculationCase; place that property on the local-frame case and validate that it identifies the same structuralMember reached via hasStructuralMember, without duplicating operand facts. Make every declared applicability input, formula operand, and result required with appropriate minCount, including netLocalFrameFlangeArea, netAttachedShellPlateThickness, frameSpacing, framingAngleOmega, all listed structural-member operands, plasticNeutralAxisHeight, netEffectivePlasticSectionModulus, and interpolation point coordinate/result values where applicable. Missing selector or operand evidence must violate rather than silently bypass the SPARQL checks. The interpolation applicability check currently requires both endpoints in one FILTER NOT EXISTS pattern, so a case missing only one endpoint passes; enforce lower and upper endpoint presence independently for 20<framingAngleOmega<70, and reject either endpoint outside that interval. Keep endpoints non-mandatory for non-oblique angles, while ensuring the angle and its owner/path are present.

Do not freeze. Preserve the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary and all prior instructions. Correct the owner of netEffectivePlasticSectionModulus: its canonical requiredOwner is structuralMember, but the candidate currently places it on calculationCase; constrain it on the supplied structuralMember reached via hasStructuralMember, without duplicating that member. Remove unconditional sh:minCount 1 for plasticNeutralAxisHeight and both interpolation endpoints. z_na is required only when 100*A_fn > 1000*t_pn*s; interpolation lower and upper endpoints are required independently only when 20<framingAngleOmega<70, and either endpoint must be rejected outside that interval. Keep the existing independent missing-endpoint SPARQL checks, and ensure missing applicability inputs or operand evidence violates rather than bypasses the checks.

Do not freeze. Preserve the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary and all prior instructions. Remove the invalid `sh:hasValue [ sh:this true ]` constraint on `sectionCalculationCaseStructuralMember`: `sh:hasValue` compares against that blank node and does not express identity with the enclosing structural member, so it can make valid data fail or encode the wrong relationship. Keep `sh:minCount 1; sh:maxCount 1` on the property and enforce identity only with the existing SPARQL check (or an equivalent explicit same-node constraint) between the linked local-frame case member and the supplied structural member reached through `hasStructuralMember`.
